vb_textbox.text: Before my session, I received advice to choose the colourful gnome and this seemed to give good results - earning 4-9 mushrooms per round. When choosing the dull-coloured gnome instead it only gave 1-3 mushrooms. These are general figures - there were occasions where the colourful gnome gave a small number or even zero mushrooms for a few successive rounds, but it came back to 4-9 mushrooms quite quickly.
